## FieldType type

Resolves the field type addressed by a dot-separated path.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FieldType<T, Path = PartialDottedKeys<T>> = T extends null ? FieldType<Exclude<T, null>, Path> | null : T extends undefined ? FieldType<Exclude<T, undefined>, Path> | undefined : Path extends keyof T ? T[Path] : Path extends `${infer Left}.${infer Right}` ? Left extends keyof T ? FieldType<T[Left], Right> : never : never;
```
